training.0:
Take the starting resources from the base.
<Click on the base> -> <Storage> -> <Click on resources>
training.1:
Place a drill on the titanium deposit.
The deposit is the rocks sticking out of the sand.
Don't forget to take 5 titanium from the base!
<Click on the drill> -> <Working>
training.2:
Collect the titanium from the drill.
<Click on the drill> -> <Storage> -> <Click on the resources>
training.3:
Connect the drill to the base with a conveyor.
Don't forget to pick up titanium into your inventory!
Use the <R> key to rotate conveyors.
training.5:
Build the <Launch Pad>.
Send 50 units of titanium through it.
